title: Cruise & Boat Party
description: Prépare-toi pour une des soirées les plus folles de Paris… sur l’un des plus gros bateaux de la capitale 🚢🕗 De 20h à 5h, on te fait vivre une expérience complète :✨ Croisière sur la Seine 🌃 Vue incroyable sur Paris by night🎧 Puis ouverture de la boîte à bord pour enchaîner jusqu’au bout de la nuitOnly boat à partir de 23hEntre internationaux, Erasmus et étudiants parisiens, l’ambiance va être électrique du début à la fin 🌍Attends-toi à danser sous le ciel de Paris, entouré de centaines d’étudiants venus du monde entier…🍹 Drinks, musique, vibes internationales🔥 Une seule mission : profiter à fond🚨 Les places partent toujours très vite pour ce genre d’événementErasmus, International, au pair ou stagiaire, tu es le bienvenu !

title: Coffee Party
venue: Matchai and Coffee : 10 Rue La Boétie, 75008 Paris
description: COFFEE PARTY - Sip, Vibe & Repeat! Have you ever thought of partying in a coffee shop? Well, now is your chance! Come hang out, sip on some really good coffee, and enjoy great music in a cozy café atmosphere. Not a coffee person? No worries, other drinks are on the menu too :) ???? DJ set + a secret guest ☕ Good coffee, good drinks (1 drink is included in your ticket) ✨ International crowd, new connections ???? November 14th, 2026 - from 2 PM to 6 PM Bring your friends, meet new people, grab your favorite drink, and let’s turn an ordinary afternoon into something special!

title: Movie Night Amélie Poulain
venue: l’Épée de Bois, 100 Rue Mouffetard, 75005 Paris
description: Movie Night: Amélie ✨ Ready for a proper French cinema night in the heart of the Quartier Latin? Join us on Sunday, November 15th for a screening of Le Fabuleux Destin d’Amélie Poulain (in French with English subtitles). ???? We’ll grab drinks first at 7 PM, followed by the movie screening at 8 PM, both at Cinéma Épée du Bois. Amélie is an absolute French classic, and frankly, it's pretty much impossible to live in Paris without seeing this movie! It showcases so many spots across Paris, so it’ll be super fun recognising places you’ve seen in real life or discovering brand-new hidden corners as the film goes. It follows Amélie, a quiet young waitress caught up in her own imaginative world, who decides to secretly help the people around her find happiness. Her quest to spread joy ultimately leads her to true love. Don't worry if your French is a bit rusty: the film has English subtitles, so everyone can follow along! ???? ????️ Spots available: 20 - grab yours quick, space is pretty limited!

title: Hiking along the Yerres
description: Hey everyone! Ready for a little escape from Paris? ????✨ Join us on November 15, 2026 for a day full of nature and good vibes with ESN! ✨ ???? Meeting point: 11:10 AM at Gare de Lyon We’ll enjoy a 9 km scenic walk along the Yerres River, surrounded by nature and away from the hustle and bustle of the city. ???? It’s the perfect opportunity to meet new people, get some fresh air, and enjoy a relaxing day away from Paris! ???? If the weather isn’t on our side, we’ll swap the walk for a cozy time at a bar instead! ????✨ ⚠️ ESNcard mandatory

title: Paris Is A Joke - Standup Comedy In English
description: 🎤🇫🇷 PARIS IS A JOKE - EPISODE 2! 😂 🔥 AFTER A SOLD-OUT FIRST EDITION, WE'RE BACK! You laughed, you loved it, and you asked for more… So here we go again! 🎤 PARIS ERASMUS LIFE brings you another unforgettable night of international stand-up comedy in the heart of Paris! 🌍 Different Nationalities. Different Cultures. One Language: LAUGHTER! From French stereotypes to cultural clashes, Erasmus adventures, dating disasters and the everyday madness of living in Paris… Nothing is off-limits! 😂 ✨ WHAT TO EXPECT? 🎤 International stand-up comedians 😂 100% Comedy in ENGLISH 🌍 Cultural differences & hilarious stereotypes 🇫🇷 Jokes about Parisian life 🤝 Meet internationals, expats & Erasmus students 🍸 Drinks, laughter & great vibes! 📅 SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 15TH, 2026 🕖 Doors Open: 7:00 PM 📍 ENVOLE MOI - 176 Rue Montmartre, Paris 2nd 🚇 Grands Boulevards / Bourse 🎟️ START AT €10 - LIMITED SPOTS! Our first edition SOLD OUT, so don't wait until the last minute to grab your ticket! ❤️ Whether you're French, Erasmus, expat or just visiting Paris, everyone is welcome! Paris is a joke. And we're just getting started! 🇫🇷😂

title: Tour Eiffel Night Climb ✨
venue: Tour Eiffel, Av. Gustave Eiffel, 75007 Paris
description: Join us for an unforgettable evening as we climb the Eiffel Tower by night! Experience the magic of the Eiffel Tower's sparkling lights up close while meeting other international students and making new friends.

title: Visit Musée de Cluny
description: Visit Musée de Cluny and discover the world's most iconic alchemist with ESN Paris! Join us for a cultural morning visit at Musée de Cluny, located in the heart of the Latin Quarter. Nearly as old as Paris this place has served as Roman baths, as an abbey, as a palace and even as storage for the city’s sculptures. Nowadays Cluny is a national museum specialised in medieval history. We invite you to discover its temporary exhibition where you will discover the real history of Nicolas Flamel, a figure that has inspired our literature and pop culture. After the visit we’ll enjoy lunch and a drink in a restaurant nearby! The event will take place on November 28th. We will meet at 10:30 at 28 Rue du Sommerard. The event is free for UE citizens between 16-25 years old ????We recommend the other visitors who don’t have their free entry to buy their ticket in advance at the official website: https://billetterie.musee-moyenage.fr/fr/collection-permanente

title: Kiss My Erasmus
description: Ça commence à sentir la fin… mais pas tout à fait. Avant la vraie dernière, on se retrouve pour une grosse soirée au au Café Oz. C’est la première des “goodbye parties”, celle où on commence à réaliser que l’aventure Erasmus touche bientôt à sa fin. Pas de discours, pas de larmes (pas encore) juste une belle excuse pour danser encore une fois avec tous ceux qu’on a croisés pendant ces mois de folie. Si t’as envie de profiter jusqu’au bout, c’est maintenant.

title: Celine on the Seine - The Tribute Cruise Experience
description: ENGLISH BELOW CÉLINE ON THE SEINE - THE CRUISE EXPERIENCE Elle revient sur scène à Paris. On fête ça sur la Seine. Que tu aies eu ta place pour la résidence ou pas - cet événement est fait pour toi. Le temps d'une croisière, on rend hommage à celle qui continue de faire chavirer des générations entières. Entre fans, entre passionné.e.s, on embarque ensemble pour un après-midi hommage à Céline ! ???? CE QUI T'ATTEND À BORD ???? Un DJ 100 % Céline - De "Pour que tu m'aimes encore" à "The Power of Love", de "S'il suffisait d'aimer" à "I'm Alive" : pendant toute la croisière, la playlist ne joue qu'elle - de ses premiers tubes francophones à ses hymnes internationaux. ???? Paris comme décor, Céline comme bande-son - La Tour Eiffel, le Pont Alexandre III, Notre-Dame, le Louvre qui défile... Chaque monument iconique de Paris prend une autre dimension quand "L'Hymne à l'amour" résonne sur l'eau. C'est une promesse : tu ne regarderas plus jamais ces paysages sans entendre sa voix. ???? Une violoniste live - Pour des moments d'émotion. Elle transforme le pont du bateau en scène à ciel ouvert. ???? Une surprise à bord - On ne dit rien.
